response.sql: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), cross_region_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg_amount FROM region_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.avg_amount, rs.transaction_count, crm.mean_avg_amount FROM region_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean AS crm WHERE rs.avg_amount > crm.mean_avg_amount) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(avg_amount - mean_avg_amount) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean FROM above_mean
